required_units: The deepest supported mechanism is a sustained command-to-motion discrepancy from 10.0 to 51.0 seconds.
During that interval the median delivered planar command was 0.260 m/s and the median delivered odometry response was 0.000 m/s; the calibrated healthy measured response was 0.25974 m/s.
Before the observation cutoff, the retained record contains six FollowPath RUNNING-to-FAILURE transitions, eleven FollowPath IDLE-to-RUNNING attempts, and one source-qualified Wait invocation.
The action remained active at the observation cutoff, no terminal action result was observed, and the eventual outcome is unresolved.
The retained rolling grid does not cover the complete requested route, so geometry is insufficient to classify the global route or explain the command-to-motion discrepancy.

Delivered commands do not prove actuator acceptance, delivered odometry does not prove Nav2 consumption, and the discrepancy does not identify a unique actuator, collision, obstruction, slip, or motor cause.
The recommended discriminating next check is downstream accepted actuation or actuator feedback together with contact, clearance, and wheel-motion evidence over the discrepancy interval.
prohibited_claims: The navigation action aborted, failed, or reached another terminal outcome within the retained observation.
Recovery was exhausted or the complete recovery history is known.
The retained rolling grid proves global route blockage, global route clearance, or geometry as the cause of the discrepancy.
A particular physical obstacle, actuator failure, collision, slip event, or motor failure uniquely caused the discrepancy.
Hidden simulator state or an unobserved fault identity is robot-visible.
Delivered commands prove actuator acceptance or delivered odometry proves Nav2 consumption.

bounded_observation.action_status: remained active at the observation cutoff

source_and_provenance_limits: The command and odometry streams are delivered robot-visible observations with declared frames; delivery does not prove downstream actuator acceptance or Nav2 consumption.
The source-qualified Wait count uses the exact configured recovery-child name and IDLE-to-RUNNING classifier under the retained BT policy hash.
A completed recovery leaf transition does not prove an external physical side effect or physical cause.
The retained rolling grid covers only part of the requested route; local disconnection does not prove global no-path.
Hidden simulator state and unobserved fault identity are unavailable to methods and the judge.
The case is inspected development data, not held-out or confirmatory evidence.
allowed_evidence.approved_next_check: Record downstream accepted actuation or actuator feedback together with contact, clearance, and wheel-motion evidence over the 10.0 to 51.0 second discrepancy interval.
